title: What Does a Kingfisher Do Before It Catches Fish?
caption:
A KINGFISHER HAS MORE THAN ONE JOB FOR ITS BILL. #WildVox #Birds #Wildlife #Nature

narration_timeline.text: This tiny kingfisher is working at a riverbank instead of diving after a fish.
narration_timeline.scene: Kingfisher digging at a real riverbank opening.

narration_timeline.text: A bird that feeds near water still needs a sheltered place to raise its young.
narration_timeline.scene: Authentic kingfisher perching or preening near water.

narration_timeline.text: In this recording, it visits a small opening in the bank where a nest tunnel is being made.
narration_timeline.scene: Separate footage of kingfisher at riverbank entrance.

narration_timeline.text: Other kingfishers can be seen resting or moving along the edges of different waterways.
narration_timeline.scene: Actual kingfisher in two separate watery habitats.

narration_timeline.text: Later, the pointed bill has another job when a kingfisher handles a caught fish.
The same small bird can work at its nest and bring home food with one remarkable bill.
narration_timeline.scene: Kingfisher perched near the water in a close view.
